Tilak Chandlo Day

A Special 'Tilak Chandlo' day was declared to inspire children, teenagers, youths and devotees to do tilak-chandlo. To celebrate this special day the sanctum sanctorum of Thakorji was aesthetically displayed with sets of daily puja and all its instruments of worship. The mammoth Sunday assembly commenced with the sharing of personal experiences regarding the impact of the tilak-chandlo by children, youths and senior devotees. Swamishri was then honoured with a garland of tilak-chandlo.

In his blessings Swamishri emphasised, "We are the disciples of Shriji Maharaj and He has given us the Shikshapatri to abide by. In it there is an injunction for daily puja and the application of tilak-chandlo daily. Every religion has prescribed its own religious mark. By doing the tilak-chandlo we are not losing anything. We should do it to please God. It gives us inner strength and helps us in our daily life. But we are mindful of what others will say. Not doing it is our own mental weakness. Because of the growing western influence in India, we believe the tilak-chandlo is out of fashion and thus refrain from doing it. Another reason for not doing it is that we feel that it will not be good for business. To do tilak-chandlo is our duty. We should do it in order to please God and His holy Sadhu. Whoever will start doing Tilak-chandlo then his wishes will be fulfilled by God."
Swamishri's blessings were received with a thunderous applause of approval and commitment. The Sunday assembly was attended by more than 10,000 devotees.
Swamishri sanctified a paper mill complex and performed the Murti pratishtha of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Radha Krishna Dev and Guru Parampara at the newly built Swaminarayan Mandir.

At 10.30 a.m., Swamishri inaugurated the BAPS 'Pramukh Swami Institute of Information Technology' (PIIT). As part of its educational services the BAPS has built a modern institute to provide computer education for tribal children. After performing the curtain raising ceremony of a plaque, Swamishri and dignitaries inaugurated the PIIT. Thereafter, Swamishri sanctified the various departments of the institute. In the inaugural assembly, Pujya Viveksagar Swami gave an introduction about the BAPS educational and tribal uplift activities. Thereafter Swamishri blessed the assembly, "When a person is educated, he can properly serve the society, country and religion. Along with education children should also be provided with values..."

Devotees from Samudral in Maharashtra, a village reconstructed by BAPS after the earthquake in 1993, sang dhun and bhajans. One hundred and thirty-two devotees had arrived for the murti-pratishtha function, out of which forty-two had pilgrimaged by foot, covering a distance of 142 km from Samudral.

While Pramukh Swami Maharaj, seated in his wheelchair, was going towards the lift, Hasmukhbhai, who had come from Harare, was standing there. He had brought his elder brother Babubhai specially for darshan. Introducing his elder brother, he said to Swamishri, "This is my elder brother Babubhai. He is 85 years old. In 85 years of life he has not yet set foot in a single mandir. He is coming into a mandir for the very first time, and the reason is his wish for your darshan."

During the introduction, Swamishri spoke of the family of Shamalbhai Chaturbhai in Bhadran and said to him, "You too come from that same family." Saying this, Swamishri described the characteristics of his father and uncle. He was very pleased. Finally, blessing him, Swamishri said, "You are our very own. So from now on, come to the mandir."
Such selfless love of Swamishri kindles the flame of faith in God in thousands of hearts.

The well known columnist Shri Jay Vasavada had written an article on Delhi's "Swaminarayan Akshardham" in the Wednesday supplement of "Gujarat Samachar", praising this supreme work of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Blessing him, Swamishri said, "You have written a very beautiful article on Akshardham. My blessings to you."
Jaybhai said, "Bapa! I wrote the article, but by oversight I left out writing your name." Hearing this, Swamishri said, "Since you wrote about Akshardham, our name has come into it."

When Pramukh Swami Maharaj returned to his residence after puja, just like yesterday, today too Swamishri gave joy to Prayasvinbhai by talking with him for five or ten minutes. During the conversation Swamishri said, "Relationships with everyone are a very great thing. Relationships with ordinary people are even more important."
Prayasvinbhai said, "As my father used to say, I too feel in my mind that we have earned a lot, but I want our employees to earn too and the country of India to progress."
Swamishri said, "Not wanting to take everything for oneself alone is a very good feeling."

ds.t: Relationships with ordinary people matter more
w: After puja, when Swamishri came to his residence, just like yesterday he gave joy to Prayasvinbhai by talking with him for five or ten minutes. During the conversation Swamishri said, "Good relationships with everyone are a very big thing. Relationships with ordinary people are even more important."
Prayasvinbhai said, "As my father used to say, I also feel that we have earned a lot, but I want our employees to earn too and for India to rise."
Swamishri said, "Not 'let me alone make everything my own'. That is a very good feeling."

ds.t: If you want to remove it
w: After darshan in the mandir, Mahant Swami Maharaj was moving on, giving darshan to the devotees, when youths and devotees sitting on the lawn were singing a kirtan:
"Listen, sister, to the way to please Hari: the beloved Mohan is at enmity with ego."
As Swamishri came near, they asked, "Swami! Our ego will go, won't it?"
"If you want to remove it, it will go."
Swamishri's unexpected answer made everyone look within.

ds.t: The chief of the Western Range
w: Shri Ajaybhai Tomar, chief of the entire Western Range, came today to meet Mahant Swami Maharaj. Under him, 20,000 BSF soldiers are protecting India on the Pakistan border.
Brahmviharidas Swami said, "His only wish was to be touched by you just once."
Then he was asked, "Do you have any other wish?"
Ajaybhai said, "No, I just want blessings."
He fell at Swamishri's feet, took his blessings and then took leave.
Coming out, he said to Brahmviharidas Swami, "The inner contentment I saw on Mahant Swami Maharaj's face, I have not seen on anyone's face."

The next day he phoned Brahmviharidas Swami: "I am now feeling complete peace." Speaking further, he said, "If there is anyone who can save our Hindu dharma and culture, it is Mahant Swami Maharaj and BAPS."
What a wonderful effect even a brief contact with Swamishri has!
In the evening assembly, speaking on one of his favourite subjects, "the servant of servants", Mahant Swami Maharaj said:

"Only one who becomes the servant of servants is perfected. Nothing is left for us. We have been scholars, pandits, kings, Indra, everything... Maharaj says, 'Being a servant is an honour.' Not grudgingly, like a dying cow flicking its ear. Say it with pride: 'We are servants of God.' The fruit of chanting, austerity, renunciation and detachment is only this, that we consider ourselves the servant of the servant of God's devotee. In this satsang, the real value lies in this alone. The status of servant is not useless or worthless; it is the best. 'He who remains the servant of servants in satsang; I will consider his devotion good and delight in his colour.' If you want to be immersed in God, to embrace God, then become the servant of servants. In this there is no risk, no problem... delight in servitude, humility and glory.
"Do your best, leave the rest. What need is there of all the rest? We have taken countless births. We have done a great many other things.

"Wrong, right, doing as we pleased... In this birth we have met God for the very first time. It is a matter of 5 to 25 years. If we lose that and go off on this path or that, how great the loss! So bow to God, the sadhus and the devotees, and a great deal of work will be done."

After giving blessings in the evening assembly, Mahant Swami Maharaj entered the meeting hall. A youth named Tushar, who studies philosophy, asked, "If Aksharbrahma is in human form, does he have human traits? For example, catching illnesses, wanting to eat, and so on..."
Swamishri gave an exact answer in one word: "He shows them..." That is, Aksharbrahma does not have all these human traits, but he shows them.
